notes: Official names and descriptions as published on PlayStation Network, cross-checked on PlanetGTA6, Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-21. Guides are this guide's own words. Five trophies were still unsolved in every published guide on that date and are marked unsolved here instead of guessed.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. No multiplayer or DLC is needed; everything is single-player. Budget roughly 200 hours for the full road to platinum.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy from the first mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It unlocks on its own as you play; nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The chapter turns over when you start the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It pops when Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. It pops after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the game. It is the same mission that closes Chapter 4, so this gold pops together with the Chapter 4 trophy. Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Story trophy, unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story. The list is forgiving, closer to 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, and 70 of 80 challenges. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable in free-roam.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Do any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridge runs are the quickest. Track progress by region in Progress, Activities, Stunts. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going after this pops.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, video games, races and stunts. Check Progress, Activities to see which types you still owe. Most come naturally during the story, so this usually pops without grinding.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold at all 12 shooting-range locations, 42 gold medals in total. Medals are per challenge, not per visit, so replay a range until every one of its challenges shows gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations, 42 races in total. You only need one win per location, so skip the tracks you hate and come back to them later.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races each count as their own location, and the game lists 40 unique race spots, so there is plenty of choice.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple map icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. You must reach the end of the game; beating every challenge inside it is not required.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. In Chapter 3 Andy calls, then texts her Belville address. Finish all 5 Andy quests: Climbing the Cellerichain parts 1 to 3, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams. He marks treasure-dive spots with purple chest icons; clear 7 shipwrecks with the metal detector and bring the loot back. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1, so call Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 to get him texting again.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands that the game counts. Confirmed counters: Kirk and the Skunk Ape, Kyle at McKittrick Farm, Yago and his street races, Pilot Pete and his deliveries. More strangers are still being mapped. Note that Andy, Billy, Moses and Tyrone do not count toward this one. All strands stay open after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City. Steal them anywhere or follow his marked locations; a clean delivery pays more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers point at synthetic labs in Vice City. Destroy them in Take Out Kitty Litter until Tyrone hands you the Spin On This job.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot: 18 spots across 10 locations, and each one counts twice if both Jason and Lucia meditate there. Track them in Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: during Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning. She walks out to the balcony to meditate; follow her and choose Accept. That first meditation is gone for good after Chapter 1, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it while you can. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter; the game gives you 15 slots.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline, Jason-only, starts after Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason about Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. His hunts ask for specific animals; bring them back to Bret. He hands you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle on the first quest. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 set locations mapped across Leonida. Cards are a pure collectible hunt with no story gate, so sweep them up during free-roam cleanup.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots: hold Up, then R1, on anything scannable. The set breaks down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags, and there are more than 100 in total, so scan whatever you pass.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges in Progress, Challenges. You need 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way there. Pick the easy ones and leave the hardest 10 alone.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Once you can free-roam as a pair, after Coffee Break, call your partner with Right plus Triangle, build a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. A fast sports bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works well because the helicopter cannot follow you there. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, rob 3 shops back-to-back without dropping the wanted level. Keep the red and blue flashing wanted state; do not let it cool off or spike to full heat. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, are a good run. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app: hold Up, then R1, while looking at a vehicle. Standing on a busy road and scanning passing traffic is fastest. You do not need to drive them. The 100% checklist wants 200 scans, so this comes free on the way.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one Combat Focus, L3 plus R3 while aiming, drop 5 enemies. Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline to stretch it, wear body armor, use a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556, and line the targets up at a gang operation. It does not seem to count on police, soldiers or civilians. Focus reaches level 4 naturally by the endgame, which makes this far easier.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a big passenger plane docked at a VCIA departure terminal. E3 and E4 is the easiest: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge, get in the cockpit, reverse to the strip, take off and fly 1 km away from the airport. Planes parked on the open airfield do not count.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map. The tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive in through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 you own the Snap Gun. Break into a jewelry store through the back door with it instead of kicking the door, find the safe code note in the back room, open the safe and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good first try.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Unlocked by the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, bring your partner to carry a second bag, then escape the 4-star heat. After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip. Any 5 of the 8 large bank jobs count; all 8 are needed for 100%.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Same unlock as the bank vaults: tailing the armored truck to the bank in That's Where The Money Is counts as robbing it. Or do it earlier: block an armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and escape the heat radius.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map of Leonida. A plane is fastest: sweep over every blacked-out region until the map is fully visible.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total and all 39 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way. They show as yellow icons when you get close, and Progress, Gangs tracks how many per gang you have hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNSOLVED. As of 21 Nov 2026 no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. The description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but the exact trigger is still unknown. This guide will not guess; check back after the community cracks it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNSOLVED. As of 21 Nov 2026 no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. The description suggests smashing out of a vehicle showroom, but no verified steps exist yet. Not guessed here.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway, opened with sticky bombs. It pops after you escape the police, not on pickup. You can come back later for anything you missed, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Get maximum strength on BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check it in Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, Strength. Work out together: call your partner with Right plus Triangle and train at a fitness club, or at home after the story. While one trains, the other progresses too.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Do 500 actions that move your criminal profile; the trophy list itself shows your count. Turn on criminal-profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications and play normally: robberies, escapes and fights all count, and it comes passively. Profile tiers run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, Irredeemable, and the last one is permanent, so do not farm it by running over civilians.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNSOLVED. As of 21 Nov 2026 no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. The community suspects the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but that is unverified. Not guessed here.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: UNSOLVED. As of 21 Nov 2026 no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. The community suspects a UFO questline, but that is unverified. Not guessed here.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNSOLVED. As of 21 Nov 2026 no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. The community suspects kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, but that is unverified. Not guessed here.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check you get the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then deliver $250,000 of marked bills in total to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays best. Bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in one hit.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops: weapons, clothes, cars, anything with a price tag. It counts cumulatively across the whole game, so buy what you need as you play and check your spending in the stats if it has not popped by the endgame.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida through the in-game property listings. They are pricey, so save this for the endgame, when bank jobs pay up to $205,000 a vault.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Steal or buy a vehicle, open the app and register it, then repeat with 10 different vehicles. Any car counts, so the cheapest ones are fine.
trophies.name: On the Spot
